device_entry.name: Arduino模数采集器
tags: 电压监测与传感器信号采集
device_entry.description: 基于Arduino的模数采集装置，通过网络连接读取模拟电压并转换为数字信号，适合实验中采集传感器、电压输出等低速模拟量数据。
device_entry.description_en: An Arduino-based analog-to-digital acquisition device that reads analog voltages over a network connection and converts them into digital values. It is suitable for laboratory acquisition of low-speed analog signals such as sensor outputs and general voltage measurements.

schema.description_en: Connect to the Arduino ADC device.
